chunks: So We made those of Our creatures whom We had chosen, heirs to the Book; but some of these exceed themselves, and some follow the middle course, and some surpass others in goodness by God's will, which is the greatest blessing.
ai.seo_question: What are the three types of people who received the Book according to this verse?
ai.summary: While the verse appears in Surah Al-Furqan, Shia exegetes often link it to Surah Fatir (35:32) due to the identical phrasing, interpreting the 'Book' as both the Quran and the Ahl al-Bayt's spiritual inheritance. The three categories of recipients reflect the spiritual hierarchy of the Ummah, with the 'excellers' (sābiqūn) representing the highest tier of fidelity, a concept deeply resonant with the Shia emphasis on the Imams as the ultimate exemplars of divine favor.
